band.rationale: 对照第二、四档描述后定为第三档：本文『基本完成了试题规定的任务』，图表三项数据与原因分析、个人评论等多数内容要点已覆盖；『有一些语法结构或词汇方面的错误，但不影响理解』（如 does not provides、volunteer activities is、35 percentage）；『采用简单的衔接手法，内容基本连贯，层次基本清晰』（Firstly/Secondly/In my opinion 串联，三段 47/45/43 词均衡）。达不到第四档『语言基本准确，只有在试图使用较复杂结构或较高级词汇时才有个别错误』及『使用较丰富的语法结构和词汇』的要求，故不进第四档；对目标读者基本产生了预期的效果，也高于第二档『未能按照要求完成试题规定的任务』的水平。

dimensions.name: 切题与图表解读
dimensions.evidence: 35 percentage of students never join in volunteer activities, while 45 percentage of them take part in one to two times every month. Only 20 percentage students join three times or more.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 三项数据（35%/45%/20%）均已覆盖且数值与类目对应正确，任务要求的描述与评论两部分都完成；但缺少对图表主要特征的概括与比较（如多数学生参与频次偏低），且数据表达用语多处有误。

dimensions.name: 内容展开与评论
dimensions.evidence: some students think study is more important than volunteer work, so they spend all their time in the library
dimensions.deduction_reason: 两条原因均只有一句、无例证或深入解释；评论部分（learn skill and make friend / should offer more chances）笼统单薄，未具体展开志愿服务的益处。

dimensions.name: 组织与段落逻辑
dimensions.evidence: Firstly, some students think study is more important... Secondly, the school does not provides... In my opinion, volunteer activities is good for students.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 三段结构（描述—原因—评论）均衡清晰，衔接词使用得当；但存在逗号粘连句 "...volunteer activities, many students don't know how to join."，削弱句际连贯。

dimensions.name: 语法与句式控制
dimensions.evidence: the school does not provides enough information; volunteer activities is good for students; balance the the study and volunteer work
dimensions.deduction_reason: 助动词后动词形式、主谓一致、可数名词复数、逗号粘连、相邻重复词等基础错误密集（约 10 处/135 词），虽不阻碍理解但远超『个别错误』；句式有一定变化（while 对比、Only in this way 倒装）仅部分补救。

dimensions.name: 词汇与搭配
dimensions.evidence: 35 percentage of students; learn skill and make friend; the situation of students taking part in volunteer activities
dimensions.deduction_reason: percent/percentage 误用贯穿三处；volunteer activities、join/take part in 高频重复；用词与搭配整体停留在最基础水平。

dimensions.name: 格式与卷面
dimensions.evidence: The chart shows... In my opinion... Only in this way can we grow up better.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 议论文体裁与分段格式正确、语域合理；字数 135 为建议下限 150 的 90%（soft_ok），按规则不机械罚分，仅提示略短。

consistency.adjustments: 初评维度和 3.5+1.5+1.5+0.5+0.5+1=8.5，落在第三档 7–9 区间内，校验一次通过，未调整。

sentence_edits.original: The chart shows the situation of students taking part in volunteer activities in a university.
sentence_edits.issue: "the situation of students taking part in..." 语义含混、信息量低，图表作文首句宜直接点明调查对象是『每月参与频次』。
sentence_edits.revised: The chart shows how often students in a university take part in volunteer activities every month.

sentence_edits.original: 35 percentage of students never join in volunteer activities, while 45 percentage of them take part in one to two times every month.
sentence_edits.issue: percentage 是名词『百分比』这一概念，基数词后应用 percent（35 percent of...）；"take part in one to two times" 动宾搭配不当，take part in 后应接活动，频次应另置。
sentence_edits.revised: 35 percent of students never take part in volunteer activities, while 45 percent of them do so one to two times a month.

sentence_edits.original: Only 20 percentage students join three times or more.
sentence_edits.issue: "20 percentage students" 结构错误，应为 20 percent of the students；join 表示加入组织或活动，表达参加次数宜用 participate。
sentence_edits.revised: Only 20 percent of the students participate three times or more each month.

sentence_edits.original: There are many reasons for this phenomonon.
sentence_edits.issue: 拼写错误：phenomonon 应为 phenomenon。
sentence_edits.revised: There are many reasons for this phenomenon.

sentence_edits.original: Firstly, some students think study is more important than volunteer work, so they spend all their time in the library.
sentence_edits.issue: 润色建议：study 泛指学业时更地道的说法是 their studies；all their time 略绝对，most of their time 更稳妥。
sentence_edits.revised: Firstly, some students regard their studies as more important than volunteer work, so they spend most of their time in the library.

sentence_edits.original: Secondly, the school does not provides enough information about volunteer activities, many students don't know how to join.
sentence_edits.issue: 助动词 does not 后动词应用原形 provide；两个独立分句仅用逗号连接构成逗号粘连，需加连词 so 或拆成两句；句末 join 缺宾语，语义不完整。
sentence_edits.revised: Secondly, the school does not provide enough information about volunteer activities, so many students do not know how to get involved.

sentence_edits.original: In my opinion, volunteer activities is good for students.
sentence_edits.issue: 主谓一致错误：复数主语 volunteer activities 应搭配 are。
sentence_edits.revised: In my opinion, volunteer activities are good for students.

sentence_edits.original: It can help us learn skill and make friend.
sentence_edits.issue: 可数名词单复数错误：learn skill 应为 learn skills，make friend 应为 make friends；代词 It 指代复数 activities 宜改为 They。
sentence_edits.revised: They can help us learn skills and make friends.

sentence_edits.original: The school should offer more chances and students should balance the the study and volunteer work.
sentence_edits.issue: "the the" 相邻重复（与预检 mechanical_flags 一致）；泛指学习时 balance study 中 the 多余；另 chances 改 opportunities 更地道（style 层面）。
sentence_edits.revised: The school should offer more opportunities, and students should balance study and volunteer work.

sentence_edits.original: Only in this way can we grow up better.
sentence_edits.issue: "grow up better" 中式直译、搭配生硬，大学生已非『长大』阶段，宜说发展更全面。
sentence_edits.revised: Only in this way can we develop more fully.

improved_version:
The chart shows how often students in a certain university take part in volunteer activities every month. According to the chart, 35 percent of the students never participate in such activities, while 45 percent do so only one or two times a month. Merely 20 percent join in volunteer work three times or more.

Several reasons may account for this phenomenon. Firstly, some students regard their studies as more important than anything else, so they spend most of their time in the library. Secondly, the university does not provide enough information about volunteer programs, and as a result, many students simply do not know how to get involved.

In my opinion, volunteer activities benefit students in many ways, as they help us acquire practical skills and make new friends. Therefore, the university should offer more opportunities, and students should learn to balance study with volunteer work. Only in this way can we make the most of our campus life.
top_problems: 百分比表达错误贯穿全文（35/45/20 percentage 三处），数据描述这一图表作文核心任务的准确度受损。
主谓一致、助动词后动词形式、名词复数等基础语法错误密集（does not provides、activities is、make friend、the the），几乎句句有错，语言维度大幅失分。
词汇有限且重复（volunteer activities、join 反复出现），原因与评论各只有一两句、缺乏展开，内容深度不足。
practice_advice: 每周默写图表作文高频句型各两遍（The chart shows how often.../ X percent of... while Y percent.../ Several reasons may account for.../ Only in this way can we...），并在每次写完后专门自查三类点：percent 还是 percentage、动词第三人称单复数、可数名词是否漏了复数 s。

patterns: The chart shows how often ... every month
X percent of ... while Y percent ...
Several reasons may account for this phenomenon. Firstly, ... Secondly, ...
In my opinion, ... Only in this way can we ...
